craft_notes: Sthāyin: the great rite — preparation dissolving into pervasion. Rows: 1 (no-bathing verdict first), 2 (catalogue of seats kept whole), 6 (triple-level close). Rejected: numbering seats as digits — killed: names carry the body-map. Read aloud: breath-length lines, triple landing.

lines: No bathing, no preliminaries — purity won by resting in full bliss alone.

Know breath, awareness, body first as one; then sound the mantra twenty-sevenfold — crown, brow, heart, secret, frame, forth and back — since awareness wears Paramaśiva's shape: the world-course fulfilled in the Supreme — below, between, above.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra snānādikartavyānapekṣayaiva pūrṇānandaviśrāntyaiva labdhaśuddhiḥ prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃviddehaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayitvā saṃvidaś ca paramaśivarūpatvāt saptaviṃśativāraṃ mantram uccārya mūrdhavaktrahṛdguhyamūrtiṣu anulomavilomābhyāṃ viśvādhvaparipūrṇatā parameśvare aparatve parāparatve paratve 'pi ca
